entities.summary: Anatoly Dmitriyevich Myshkin is a retired Soviet and Russian professional basketball player and coach. At 6 feet 9 1⁄2 inches tall, and a weight of 210 lbs. (95 kg), he played as a combo forward. Myshkin was able to break up all of the defensive schemes in European basketball, due to his unique skill set.
